name: Matsuyuki Ame
source:
Haruki's cousin who calls him 'nii-san'.  She is very obviously in love with him, but she tries to cover it up with a thorny attitude.  An obvious tsundere.  She is a near-constant target of Haruki's desire to see naked women, as well as the first target of his invisibility act.

[spoiler]She blames herself for Haruki's childhood injury which makes it impossible for him to do hard physical activities.  As such, she is willing to put up with a lot from him that no sane girl would normally.[/spoiler]
